cards.title: AI 会写，不等于 AI 会负责
cards.description_en: A programmer asks an AI assistant who takes responsibility for approving generated changes.
cards.description_zh: 程序员询问 AI：谁对生成改动的批准负责。
cards.communication_goal: 明确 AI 提供建议，人类对批准结果负责。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Before I sign off on the changes, who takes responsibility for the result?
dialogue.zh: 在我批准这些改动前，谁对结果负责？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: You remain accountable for what you approve. I can suggest code, but I cannot own the outcome.
dialogue.zh: 你仍要对自己批准的内容负责。我可以建议代码，但不能替你承担结果。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: I'll use this clipboard to record checks and verify the behavior myself before we ship.
dialogue.zh: 我会用这张夹板记录检查结果，并在交付前亲自验证行为。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Good. Check the tests and review anything that affects users.
dialogue.zh: 好的。检查测试，并审查任何影响用户的改动。

roles.B: AI assistant AI 助手（OpenAI Logo）

words.example: Before I sign off on the changes, who takes responsibility for the result?
words.translation: 在我批准这些改动前，谁对结果负责？
words.evidence: 责任由对白明确提出，不能从签署手势或夹板外观判定。

words.example: You remain accountable for what you approve. I can suggest code, but I cannot own the outcome.

words.evidence: 对批准结果负责是对白中的责任关系，没有局部可见指代。

words.example: I'll use this clipboard to record checks and verify the behavior myself before we ship.

words.evidence: 验证尚未发生，图片不证明测试结果。

words.example: I'll use this clipboard to record checks and verify the behavior myself before we ship.

words.evidence: 完整可见的夹板及顶部纸夹是 clipboard 的直接指代。

cards.title: 选对任务再开工
cards.description_en: A programmer and an AI assistant choose a suitable first task and discuss its risk.
cards.description_zh: 程序员与 AI 选择适合先做的任务，并讨论其风险。
cards.communication_goal: 优先挑选边界清晰、易验证的任务。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Which task in this notebook is suitable for you to start with?
dialogue.zh: 这个笔记本里的哪项任务适合让你先开始？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: A routine formatting change is a good first task.
dialogue.zh: 常规的格式调整很适合作为第一项任务。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: What about changing the login flow?
dialogue.zh: 那修改登录流程呢？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: That carries more risk. Keep it small and review the security decisions yourself.
dialogue.zh: 那样的风险更高。缩小改动范围，并亲自审查安全方面的决定。

roles.B: AI assistant AI 助手（OpenAI Logo）

cards.title: 什么时候应该自己接手？
cards.description_en: A programmer pauses uncertain AI edits and takes over at the keyboard.
cards.description_zh: 程序员暂停 AI 不确定的修改，并接过键盘亲自检查。
cards.communication_goal: 发现反复试错时暂停修改、交接证据。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: You've changed the same function three times. Should I intervene?
dialogue.zh: 你已经修改同一个函数三次了。我该介入吗？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Yes. I'm uncertain about the root cause, so please pause the edits.
dialogue.zh: 是的。我不确定根因，所以请暂停修改。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: I'll take the keyboard and inspect the failing test.
dialogue.zh: 我会接过键盘，检查失败的测试。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: I'll summarize what I tried and wait for your direction.
dialogue.zh: 我会总结已经尝试过的办法，等待你的指示。

roles.B: AI assistant AI 助手（OpenAI Logo）

cards.title: 给 AI 划清操作边界
cards.description_en: A programmer sets editing permissions for a project folder and asks the AI to confirm its scope.
cards.description_zh: 程序员为项目文件夹设定编辑权限，并要求 AI 确认操作范围。
cards.communication_goal: 区分已批准的编辑与需要另行确认的操作。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: You can edit this project folder, but do you have permission to delete files?
dialogue.zh: 你可以编辑这个项目文件夹，但你有权限删除文件吗？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: No. I'll keep the files and confirm the scope with you first.
dialogue.zh: 没有。我会保留文件，并先与你确认操作范围。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Also ask before installing packages or publishing changes.
dialogue.zh: 安装依赖包或发布改动前也要先询问。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Understood. I'll stay within the actions you've approved.
dialogue.zh: 明白。我会限定在你已经批准的操作范围内。

roles.B: AI assistant AI 助手（OpenAI Logo）

cards.title: 把“好看一点”变成可执行要求
cards.description_en: A programmer gives an AI assistant concrete spacing and alignment requirements for a screen.
cards.description_zh: 程序员向 AI 提供屏幕布局的具体间距与对齐要求。
cards.communication_goal: 把模糊审美反馈变成可检查的界面要求。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Please make the spacing on this screen more consistent.
dialogue.zh: 请让这个屏幕上的间距更一致。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: How should I align the headings and buttons?
dialogue.zh: 标题和按钮应该怎样对齐？

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Use the same left edge and leave more space between sections.
dialogue.zh: 沿同一条左边线对齐，并在各区域之间留出更多空间。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Got it. I'll show you a preview so you can check the layout.
dialogue.zh: 明白。我会展示预览，让你检查布局。

roles.B: AI assistant AI 助手（OpenAI Logo）
